name: Nitrous oxide
warning: Uses rhythmic pulsing/flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: one soft pulse as the envelope starts; barely a breath.
Light: gentle ~0.55 Hz zoom-breathe, almost no color change.

Common: full wah-wah, but felt mostly as a real zoom-breathe (the warp) rather than a brightness pulse — phase-picked frame echo + warm dimming mid-envelope; double vision begins, tied to the same wave phase as the throb so it grows/fades in sync rather than as an independent oscillation.

Strong: deep zoom-breathe, strong flanging, scintilla bursts at envelope peaks; frame-rate lag (stutter) wakes up (late curve); a soft blurred wall of organic interlocking-circle geometry breathes in with the envelope, bespoke to nitrous so it can pulse with the throb; the geometry field visibly displaces the image (geomDistort) rather than only tinting it.

Heavy: a faint glow at wave peaks, never toward white or a flash — the throb lives in the warp's zoom-breathe (pure geometry, can't read as flashing) at 0.55 Hz with only small color-channel deltas; strong correlated double vision, heavy frame lag, the geometry wall fully present and warping the image; the whole arc decays and restarts every ~25 s.
